  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Cook {{ing_01|peas}}; when skimmed, put in the sauce pan {{ing_02|finely chopped leeks}} and {{ing_03|coriander}} to be cooked [with the {{ing_01|peas}}]."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Take {{ing_04|small cuttle fish}}, most desirable because of the black liquor and cook them also."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Add {{ing_05|oil}}, {{ing_06|broth}} and {{ing_07|wine}}, {{ing_08|a bunch of leek}} and {{ing_09|[green] coriander}} and make it boil."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "When done, crush {{ing_10|pepper}}, {{ing_11|lovage}}, {{ing_12|origany}}, {{ing_13|a little wild cumin [2]}} moisten with the juice [of the {{ing_01|peas}}]."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Add {{ing_07|wine}} and {{ing_14|raisin wine}} to taste; mince the {{ing_04|fish}} very fine, incorporate it with the {{ing_01|peas}}, and sprinkle with {{ing_10|pepper}} [3]."
    }
